Emily Zhang

PhD Candidate

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Emily is a PhD candidate studying viral evolution with a focus on RNA viruses. Her dissertation research examines how viral populations adapt to host immune responses and antiviral treatments. She has developed novel bioinformatics tools for analyzing viral sequence data from clinical samples.

Areas of expertise

Viral Evolution · Bioinformatics · Genomic Analysis

Education as supplied

  • MS in Bioinformatics, UC San Diego
  • BS in Computer Science, Cornell University

Research interests

  • Viral adaptation mechanisms
  • Immune escape evolution
  • Bioinformatics tool development
  • Clinical viral genomics

Publication records as supplied

  • Zhang, E. & Chen, S. (2023). Rapid adaptation in RNA virus populations. Virus Evolution.
  • Zhang, E. et al. (2022). Novel tools for viral phylodynamic analysis. Bioinformatics.
